Short title and commencement

PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF SINDH NOTIFICATION KARACHI, THE 11TH NOVEMBER,
2014
PROVINCIAL
ASSEMBLY OF SINDH NOTIFICATION KARACHI, THE 11TH NOVEMBER, 2014
NO.PAS/Legis-B-29/2014-The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Bill, 2014 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 24th
October, 2014 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 6th November, 2014 is hereby published as anAct
of the Legislature of Sindh.
THE
SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
SINDH
ACT NO. XIX OF 2014
An act
to amend the sindh civil servants act, 1973.
WHEREAS it is expedient to
amend the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973, in the
manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as
follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2014.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: The Sindh Civil Servants Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Insertion of section 23-C in Sindh Act No.XIV of 1973

THE SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
THE
SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
SINDH
ACT NO. XIX OF 2014
An act
to amend the sindh civil servants act, 1973.
2. Insertion of section 23-C in Sindh Act
No.XIV of 1973. ---In the Sindh Civil Servants
Act, 1973, after section 23-B, the following shall be inserted:-
23-C. Appointment
of Federal Civil Servants. (1) Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act,
Government may, by notification, appoint a person to a civil service of the
Province or to a post in connection with the affairs of the Province, who
immediately before the commencement of the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment)
Act, 2010 (Act No. X of 2010) was holding a post in connection with the affairs
of the Federation and whose services have been transferred to the Province in the
wake of the said Amendment Act of 2010.
(2) Government shall, in prescribed manner,
determine the terms and conditions of service of the civil servants appointed
under sub-section (1) including cadre and seniority. .
